canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Fenen Pellan: 29-year-old man, 157 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: heart-shaped face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: one offset razor line. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: a shallow cheek scar; one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry; a dense freckle field. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
